# ClickPesa Node.js SDK

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

Production-grade Node.js / TypeScript SDK for the [ClickPesa API](https://docs.clickpesa.com) — collections (USSD Push & Card), payouts (Mobile Money & Bank), BillPay, hosted links, webhooks and more.

Works with **Express, NestJS, Next.js, Fastify, Hono** and every Node.js app. Fully typed, fully async, **zero runtime dependencies**.

## Features

- **TypeScript-first** — complete type definitions shipped with the package
- **Dual ESM + CJS builds** — works everywhere from `require` to `import`
- **Auto Auth** — JWT tokens are fetched and cached automatically (55-minute window, 1-hour API TTL); concurrent refreshes are coalesced
- **Checksum injection** — HMAC-SHA256 checksums added to every mutating request when a `checksumKey` is configured
- **Retries** — exponential backoff on transient 5xx errors and network failures (configurable)
- **Typed errors** — structured error hierarchy with `statusCode` and `response` properties
- **Webhook verification** — constant-time signature validation helper
- **Zero dependencies** — built on native `fetch` (Node >= 18)

A TypeScript port of the [clickpesa-python-sdk](https://github.com/JAXPARROW/clickpesa-python-sdk) reference implementation — byte-compatible checksums.

## Installation

### From npm (recommended)

```bash
npm install clickpesa-nodejs-sdk
# or
pnpm add clickpesa-nodejs-sdk
# or
yarn add clickpesa-nodejs-sdk
```

Requires **Node.js >= 18**.

### Directly from GitHub (before npm publication)

```bash
npm install github:mbombwe-jr/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk
```

> This installs from source and compiles on your machine via `prepare`. Prefer the npm package once published — it ships pre-built `dist/` output.

## Quick Start

```ts
import { ClickPesa } from 'clickpesa-nodejs-sdk';

const cp = new ClickPesa({
  clientId: process.env.CLICKPESA_CLIENT_ID!,
  apiKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_API_KEY!,
  checksumKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_CHECKSUM_KEY!, // optional but recommended
  sandbox: true, // set false for production
});

const balance = await cp.account.getBalance();
console.log(balance);
```

CommonJS works too:

```js
const { ClickPesa } = require('clickpesa-nodejs-sdk');
```

## Configuration

| Option        | Type      | Default | Description                                                        |
| ------------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `clientId`    | `string`  | required| Your ClickPesa application Client ID                               |
| `apiKey`      | `string`  | required| Your ClickPesa application API key                                 |
| `checksumKey` | `string?` | —       | Enables HMAC-SHA256 checksum on every mutating request             |
| `sandbox`     | `boolean` | `false` | Target sandbox (`api-sandbox.clickpesa.com`) instead of production |
| `timeoutMs`   | `number`  | `30000` | Per-request timeout in milliseconds                                |
| `maxRetries`  | `number`  | `3`     | Max retry attempts on transient server errors                      |
| `fetchImpl`   | `fetch?`  | native  | Custom fetch override (tests / proxies)                            |

> **Note:** `orderId` / `orderReference` values must be **alphanumeric only** (no hyphens, underscores or special characters).

## Collections

### USSD Push

```ts
// 1. Preview — check available methods and fees before charging
const preview = await cp.payments.previewUssdPush({
  amount: '5000',
  orderId: 'ORD20240001',
  phone: '255712345678',        // optional: include to get sender details
  fetchSenderDetails: true,
});
console.log(preview.activeMethods);

// 2. Initiate — triggers PIN prompt on the customer's phone
const tx = await cp.payments.initiateUssdPush({
  amount: '5000',
  phone: '255712345678',
  orderId: 'ORD20240001',
  currency: 'TZS',              // only TZS supported
});
console.log(tx.id, tx.status);
```

### Card Payment

```ts
// 1. Preview
await cp.payments.previewCard({ amount: '50', orderId: 'CARD001' });

// 2. Initiate — generate a hosted payment link
const result = await cp.payments.initiateCard({
  amount: '50',
  orderId: 'CARD001',
  currency: 'USD',              // only USD supported
  customer: {
    fullName: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com',
    phoneNumber: '255712345678',
  },
  // or an existing customer ID: customer: { id: 'CUST_123' },
});
console.log(result.cardPaymentLink); // redirect customer here
```

### Query Payments

```ts
await cp.payments.getStatus('ORD20240001');

const page = await cp.payments.listAll({
  status: 'SUCCESS',
  collectedCurrency: 'TZS',
  startDate: '2024-01-01',
  endDate: '2024-12-31',
  limit: 20,
  skip: 0,
});
console.log(page.totalCount, page.data);
```

## Disbursements

### Mobile Money Payout

```ts
// 1. Preview — verify fees and recipient before sending
const preview = await cp.payouts.previewMobileMoney({
  amount: 10000,
  phone: '255712345678',
  orderId: 'PAY20240001',
  currency: 'TZS',              // TZS or USD; recipient always receives TZS
});

// 2. Create — disburse funds
const payout = await cp.payouts.createMobileMoney({
  amount: 10000,
  phone: '255712345678',
  orderId: 'PAY20240001',
});
console.log(payout.id, payout.status); // AUTHORIZED → PROCESSING → SUCCESS
```

### Bank Payout (ACH / RTGS)

```ts
const banks = await cp.payouts.getBanks();
// [{ name: 'EQUITY BANK TANZANIA LIMITED', bic: 'EQBLTZTZ' }, …]

await cp.payouts.previewBank({
  amount: 500000,
  accountNumber: '1234567890',
  bic: 'EQBLTZTZ',
  orderId: 'BANK20240001',
  transferType: 'ACH',          // 'ACH' or 'RTGS'
});

const payout = await cp.payouts.createBank({
  amount: 500000,
  accountNumber: '1234567890',
  accountName: 'Jane Doe',
  bic: 'EQBLTZTZ',
  orderId: 'BANK20240001',
  transferType: 'RTGS',
});

await cp.payouts.listAll({ channel: 'MOBILE MONEY', status: 'SUCCESS', limit: 50 });
```

## BillPay

Customers pay via a numeric control number through mobile money, SIM banking and CRDB Wakalas:

- **Order** numbers — one-time, close after payment (invoices/e-commerce).
- **Customer** numbers — static, reusable per customer (subscriptions).

> Order control numbers can also be generated *offline*: concatenate your 4-digit Merchant BillPay-Namba with any internal reference (e.g. `1122` + `231256` = `1122231256`). The SDK covers API-based generation.

```ts
// One-time order control number
const cn = await cp.billpay.createOrderControlNumber({
  billReference: 'INVOICE001',  // optional — auto-generated if omitted
  billAmount: 90900,
  billDescription: 'Water Bill - July 2024',
  billPaymentMode: 'EXACT',     // or 'ALLOW_PARTIAL_AND_OVER_PAYMENT'
});
console.log(cn.billPayNumber);

// Persistent customer control number
await cp.billpay.createCustomerControlNumber({
  customerName: 'John Doe',
  customerPhone: '255712345678', // phone or email required
  billAmount: 50000,
});

// Bulk create (up to 50 per request)
await cp.billpay.bulkCreateOrderNumbers([
  { billAmount: 10000, billDescription: 'Invoice #001', billPaymentMode: 'EXACT' },
  { billReference: 'MYREF003', billAmount: 5000 },
]);

// Manage existing numbers
await cp.billpay.getDetails('55042914871931');
await cp.billpay.updateReference('55042914871931', {
  billAmount: 120000,
  description: 'Updated Water Bill',
});
await cp.billpay.updateStatus('55042914871931', 'INACTIVE');
```

## Hosted Links

```ts
// Checkout link — customer chooses their payment method
const result = await cp.links.generateCheckout({
  orderId: 'LINK001',
  orderCurrency: 'TZS',
  totalPrice: '15000',           // OR itemised orderItems — not both
  customerName: 'Jane Doe',
  customerEmail: 'jane@example.com',
});
console.log(result.checkoutLink);

// Itemised order
await cp.links.generateCheckout({
  orderId: 'LINK002',
  orderCurrency: 'USD',
  orderItems: [
    { name: 'Widget A', price: '25.00', quantity: 2 },
    { name: 'Widget B', price: '10.00', quantity: 1 },
  ],
});

// Payout link — recipient enters their own bank / mobile details
const payout = await cp.links.generatePayout({ amount: '50000', orderId: 'POUT001' });
console.log(payout.payoutLink);
```

## Account & Exchange

```ts
const { balances } = await cp.account.getBalance();
// [{ currency: 'TZS', balance: 39700 }, { currency: 'USD', balance: 0 }]

const statement = await cp.account.getStatement({
  currency: 'TZS',
  startDate: '2024-01-01',
  endDate: '2024-12-31',
});

const rates = await cp.exchange.getRates({ source: 'USD', target: 'TZS' });
// [{ source: 'USD', target: 'TZS', rate: 2510, date: '…' }]
```

## Webhook Verification

### Express

```ts
import express from 'express';
import { WebhookValidator } from 'clickpesa-nodejs-sdk';

const app = express();
app.use(express.json());

app.post('/webhooks/clickpesa', (req, res) => {
  const valid = WebhookValidator.verify({
    payload: req.body,
    signature: req.get('x-clickpesa-signature'),
    checksumKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_CHECKSUM_KEY!,
  });
  if (!valid) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid signature' });

  console.log(req.body.event, req.body.data);
  res.json({ received: true });
});
```

> ⚠️ Do **not** use `express.raw()` for this route — verification runs against the parsed JSON body object.

### NestJS

```ts
import { Controller, Post, Req, Res, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { WebhookValidator } from 'clickpesa-nodejs-sdk';

@Controller('webhooks')
export class ClickPesaWebhookController {
  @Post('clickpesa')
  handle(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response) {
    const valid = WebhookValidator.verify({
      payload: req.body,
      signature: req.headers['x-clickpesa-signature'] as string,
      checksumKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_CHECKSUM_KEY!,
    });
    if (!valid) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid signature');

    // Process event …
    return res.json({ received: true });
  }
}
```

Register it as a controller and ensure `express.json()` body parsing is active (default in NestJS).

### Next.js (App Router)

```ts
// app/api/webhooks/clickpesa/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { WebhookValidator } from 'clickpesa-nodejs-sdk';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const payload = await request.json();
  const valid = WebhookValidator.verify({
    payload,
    signature: request.headers.get('x-clickpesa-signature'),
    checksumKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_CHECKSUM_KEY!,
  });
  if (!valid) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Process event …
  return NextResponse.json({ received: true });
}
```

### Server-side payments in Next.js / NestJS

```ts
// Reuse ONE client instance across requests — token caching makes it cheap.
// lib/clickpesa.ts
import { ClickPesa } from 'clickpesa-nodejs-sdk';

export const clickpesa = new ClickPesa({
  clientId: process.env.CLICKPESA_CLIENT_ID!,
  apiKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_API_KEY!,
  checksumKey: process.env.CLICKPESA_CHECKSUM_KEY,
  sandbox: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production',
});
```

## Error Handling

All errors extend `ClickPesaError` and carry `statusCode` and `response`:

```ts
import {
  ClickPesaError,
  InsufficientFundsError,
  ConflictError,
} from 'clickpesa-nodejs-sdk';

try {
  await cp.payments.initiateUssdPush({ amount: '5000', phone: '255712345678', orderId: 'ORD001' });
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof InsufficientFundsError) {
    console.error(`Not enough balance: ${err.message}`);
  } else if (err instanceof ConflictError) {
    console.error(`Duplicate orderReference [HTTP ${err.statusCode}]`);
  } else if (err instanceof ClickPesaError) {
    console.error(`API error [${err.statusCode}]: ${err.message}`);
  }
}
```

| Error                        | Meaning                                            |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `AuthenticationError`        | 401 — invalid credentials / expired token          |
| `ForbiddenError`             | 403 — feature not enabled on your account          |
| `ValidationError`            | 400 — bad payload                                  |
| `InsufficientFundsError`     | 400 — not enough balance (extends ValidationError) |
| `NotFoundError`              | 404 — resource not found                           |
| `ConflictError`              | 409 — duplicate orderReference / billReference     |
| `RateLimitError`             | 429 — payout already in progress                   |
| `ServerError`                | 5xx — ClickPesa server error                       |
| `NetworkError`               | transport failure after exhausting retries         |
| `ClickPesaError`             | base class — catches all of the above              |

## Health Check

```ts
if (await cp.isHealthy()) {
  console.log('Connected to ClickPesa');
} else {
  console.log('API unreachable or credentials invalid');
}
```

## Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mbombwe-jr/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk.git
cd clickpesa-nodejs-sdk
npm install

npm run build      # ESM + CJS into dist/
npm test           # build + node:test suite (27 tests)
npm run typecheck  # strict TypeScript check
```

Project layout:

```
src/
├── index.ts          # ClickPesa facade + all public exports
├── client.ts         # HTTP client: auth cache, retries, checksum injection, timeouts
├── security.ts       # HMAC-SHA256 checksums & timing-safe comparison
├── exceptions.ts     # Typed error hierarchy
├── webhooks.ts       # WebhookValidator
└── services/         # payments, payouts, billpay, account, exchange, links
test/                 # node:test suite with injectable fetch mock
```

## Publishing

### One-time setup

1. **Create an npm account** at <https://www.npmjs.com/signup> if you don't have one.

2. **Log in locally:**

   ```bash
   npm login
   ```

3. **Create a GitHub repository** at <https://github.com/new> named `clickpesa-nodejs-sdk` (public), then push this project:

   ```bash
   git remote add origin https://github.com/mbombwe-jr/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk.git
   git push -u origin main        # first push will prompt for your GitHub login / PAT
   ```

4. **(Automated publishing only)** Add your npm token as a GitHub secret so the publish workflow can run:
   - Generate an **Automation**-type access token at <https://www.npmjs.com/settings/YOUR_NPM_USERNAME/tokens/granular-access-tokens/new>
   - Add it as a repository secret: *Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret*, name `NPM_TOKEN`

### Publishing a new version

**Option A — automated via GitHub Actions (recommended):**

```bash
# 1. Bump the version (choose patch | minor | major)
npm version patch          # e.g. 0.1.0 → 0.1.1

# 2. Push the code and the version tag
git push && git push --tags
```

Then on GitHub: *Releases → Draft a new release → choose the tag → Publish*.
The [publish workflow](.github/workflows/publish.yml) builds, tests and runs `npm publish` for you. You can also trigger it manually via the workflow's *Run workflow* button.

> The npm package name must be available. If `clickpesa-nodejs-sdk` is taken on npm, change `"name"` in `package.json` (e.g. to `@mbombwe-jr/clickpesa-nodejs-sdk` — scoped packages publish with `npm publish --access public`) and update the badge/README accordingly.

**Option B — manual from your machine:**

```bash
npm run test            # builds + runs the test suite
npm publish             # prepublishOnly hook rebuilds automatically
```

Verify what would be published without actually publishing:

```bash
npm publish --dry-run
```

### Verify installation works

After publishing, confirm from any machine:

```bash
npm install clickpesa-nodejs-sdk
node -e "const {ClickPesa} = require('clickpesa-nodejs-sdk'); console.log(typeof ClickPesa)"
# → function
```
